text.en:
🏆 Prizes of the Matrix demo trading contest and how they are paid

Prizes total $2,000 across 33 winners, in USDT: 1st 500, 2nd 300, 3rd 200, places 4 to 13 get 50 each, places 14 to 33 get 25 each.

Results are announced within 7 days of the end; a winner completes the prize claim steps within 14 days or the prize passes to the next. The prize is added in USDT to the winner's wallet on the platform once deposits and withdrawals open, with no trading condition.

🎥 How to join video: https://youtu.be/0tzXQOBiQyo

🔗 matrixcex.com

An educational demo contest, not investment advice.
